name: engineer
description: Engineer workbench — 6 cognitive verbs (investigate / frame / decide / compose / critique / refine) for AI-assisted engineering across Claude Code & Codex CLI

interface.longDescription: L3 persona plugin exposing six universal cognitive verbs as canonical skills (investigate, frame, decide, compose, critique, refine). Each verb is invokable as /engineer:<verb> with optional --profile and --topic arguments. Sub-discipline expansion (backend, frontend, devops, ...) flows through the L4 profile axis. Bidirectional companion ensembles (Claude ↔ Codex) dispatch automatically at every command-mode phase boundary under an always-max policy.
defaultPrompt: $engineer:investigate How is the auth token rotation flow implemented?
$engineer:frame Define the problem from these symptoms
$engineer:decide Compare two state-store options before I implement
